inspiration: Adaptive quality governor: a fuzzy controller reads the frame rate, nudges one global degrade value down quickly when frames drop and back up slowly, and the value maps to live budgets (object draw distance, particle distance, light counts). A history window stops the value chattering. Use the same shape for our phone budget on 375 wide. Refs: 2013-09 11.4186/docs/06-rendering.md lines 272-327 (the controller, docs claim; acclient.c function at line 380231 exists).

Radar blips use shape as the carrier of meaning, colour is secondary. Each contact gets a shape from a fixed set, and a priority order resolves which shape wins when several flags apply (fellow leader before fellow before allegiance before threat). Readable at 375 wide without colour. Ref: 2013-09 11.4186/docs/05-ui.md lines 459-490.

Attack windup is a visible fill that gates the swing; one stance shortens the windup and the swing auto-fires when full in the classic UI mode. Good template for our windup bar and the dual-wield or two-weapon feel. Ref: 2013-09 11.4186/docs/04-combat-magic.md lines 41-56.

Ambient beds are chosen per cell by terrain and scene type, each sound's weight falls with distance from the listener, and the mix is normalised across the set, so volume moves with the player and the crossfade happens without a timed fade. Intermittent one-shots pick a random emitter direction. Ref: 2013-09 11.4186/docs/09-audio.md lines 247-304.

Footsteps and swings are sound hooks authored into animation frames, with a random variant from a per-type table. The docs record that surface-type footsteps are missing. Keep the hook idea (sound tied to a frame); add the surface query ourselves. Ref: 2013-09 11.4186/docs/09-audio.md lines 343-383.

Camera is a spring-damper follower with separate translation and rotation stiffness, a short velocity history for lead and lag, and first person defined as a fixed head offset rather than a mode enum. Ref: 2013-09 11.4186/docs/05-ui.md lines 409-424.

Damage feedback uses a type word per damage kind with intensity tiers chosen by the fraction of max health; some types have no word and fall back to a generic verb. Ref: 2013-09 11.4186/docs/04-combat-magic.md section 5 (lines 415-448).

briefs.label: Threat-shape blip set (HUD readability)
briefs.why: Contacts marked by shape first, so threat, ally and party read at a glance on a phone without colour.
briefs.keep: shape carries meaning; a priority order when several flags apply; a small fixed set of shapes
briefs.change: our own shape set (no X or plus); a two-tone outline instead of a flat fill; threat pulses when it is aimed at you

briefs.label: Windup ring (combat readability)
briefs.why: A fill that closes over the swing tells the player when the strike lands, and a stance changes its pace. Works at 375 wide as a ring around the fighter.
briefs.keep: a visible fill that gates the swing; stance changes the pace
briefs.change: a ring around the fighter instead of a horizontal bar; the stance is a guard stance, not a weapon style; a hit-ready tick at the top

briefs.label: Biome bed mix (sound-music)
briefs.why: Ambient beds picked per biome and mixed by distance, so walking into a new area changes the air without a stinger.
briefs.keep: beds chosen by terrain and scene; weights fall with distance; normalised mix gives the crossfade
briefs.change: a short border crossfade with a stinger on entry; biome beds with our own instrumentation; a random one-shot per biome

briefs.label: Hit-flavour verbs by type (combat feedback)
briefs.why: Per-type verbs with intensity tiers give each hit a short word that matches the damage kind and size.
briefs.keep: a type word per damage kind; tiers by fraction of max health; generic fallback
briefs.change: our own verb list and a per-type sound cue; tiers by a finisher threshold instead of a plain fraction

briefs.label: Quality governor (performance)
briefs.why: A single degrade value that drops fast and recovers slowly keeps phones smooth without popping.
briefs.keep: fast drop, slow recovery; one value mapped to several budgets; hysteresis window
briefs.change: budgets for our fight camera and particle count only; a fight-start floor so the first hit is never degraded
